### Improved
- Aligned modal body content, omitted empty footers on loading sheets, replaced plain-text running footers with disabled action buttons, and removed the redundant box wrapper on clean npm cache verification results. - Redesigned the Batch Install sheet with a taller package editor, a top-right header progress counter, the sequential execution note below the item grid, zero-jump in-place status transitions, and preserved npm context through execution and results. - Redesigned the Uninstall sheet into a narrower 500pt vertical header layout with grouped Cask removal sections, shortened SHA-256 download cache names with parent directories, full-width warnings, and stable footer buttons.
### Fixed
- Fixed preparing global npm package uninstalls when the bundled manager reports `alreadyInstalled: true`. - Animated the toolbar refresh indicator during initial and background Library update checks.
## 安装
1. 打开 DMG，将 `Cellar.app` 拖到 `Applications`。 2. 移除下载隔离属性：
```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cellar.app ```
> 此版本使用 Apple Development 签名，未经 Apple 公证。

### Improved
- Compacted confirmation, completion, and progress sheets across Terminal, Tap, npm, Node, Home setup, and Maintenance views so short content hugs tightly without excess blank boxes. - Simplified the Oh My Zsh and Zsh tidy confirmation sheets by folding target paths directly into the description when no file list is needed. - Redesigned all Batch Install stages (checking indicator in footer, compact two-column review grid, live per-item spinners during execution, and unified result tiles). - Removed the duplicate spinner inside the Formula and npm uninstall modal.
### Fixed
- Retried transient GitHub API errors, shared ETag caching when verifying the official Homebrew installer, and reported API rate limits explicitly. - Fixed installing uninstalled global npm packages (such as `@antfu/ni`) on npm 11 when `npm ls -g <pkg> --depth=0 --json` omits the `dependencies` object. - Preserved Discover search query, scope, and results across sidebar switches, fixed Homebrew cards remaining stuck on Uninstall after removal, and tinted uninstall card spinners red. - Prevented the Batch Install package editor from clipping the last line horizontally after deleting rows.
## 安装
1. 打开 DMG，将 `Cellar.app` 拖到 `Applications`。 2. 移除下载隔离属性：
```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cellar.app ```
> 此版本使用 Apple Development 签名，未经 Apple 公证。

### Added
- Native macOS 26+ Apple Silicon app with task-oriented Home, Library, Discover, Environment, Maintenance, Settings, and About navigation. - Unified management for Homebrew Formulae and Casks, global npm packages bound to explicit Node environments, nvm-managed Node.js runtimes, Homebrew Taps, npm registries, and Oh My Zsh themes and plugins. - First-run onboarding guide with animated intro and completion celebration, four-step environment check, auto-closing Full Disk Access permission guidance, Command Line Tools polling, silent verified `Homebrew.pkg` installation, automatic Terminal PATH setup (`~/.zprofile`), and one-click Node.js installation via Homebrew. - App Store-style horizontal catalog cards with inline pending-update grouping, trailing circular progress indicators, sequential install/update queueing on Discover and Library cards, and global Discover search prioritizing the active tab while caching other scopes in the background. - Enhanced Homebrew Cask uninstall with ownership-verified related-data cleanup, bounded confirmation plans, and optional one-shot macOS administrator authorization. - Unified Maintenance grid with Homebrew diagnostics, npm cache verification, batch installation, bounded cleanup modals, and native macOS-style section footers across settings and environment forms. - Configurable local file logging, session diagnostics redaction, Sparkle signed updates, drag-to-install DMG packaging, and full eight-language interface localization following system preferences by default.
### Improved
- Unified uninstall, terminal, tap, npm registry, Node, and update-all sheets so confirmation, progress, and completion stay within a single modal dialog constrained to the parent window width. - Simplified the npm Registry settings layout with localized Chinese/English section headings and merged scope actions, and refined the uninstall sheet footer layout. - Unified onboarding setup cards with trailing install actions, active spinners, right-aligned completion checkmarks, and inline progress bars.
### Fixed
- Fixed Library refresh timing so pending updates reload after a manual refresh, treated `brew outdated` as authoritative for updates, and displayed actual installed `.app` versions for auto-updating Casks. - Locked onboarding navigation and window/app quit while installation or checks are running (with a single-button "Got It" alert), prevented Homebrew status from flashing "Not Installed" after silent installation, and cleared stale onboarding banners. - Hardened app termination, read-only subprocess cancellation, clean-machine startup without Node/npm or Command Line Tools, and sheet confirmation guards. - Removed the redundant global top task feedback banner, inline result cards, and Setup Guide entries from Settings and the menu bar.
## 安装

```bash sudo xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cellar.app ```
> 此版本使用 Apple Development 签名，未经 Apple 公证。
